name: my_reel
voice_direction: dry, wry, slightly smug young American woman's voice, General American accent, casual internet-creator cadence, medium-fast pace
style: 3D video game cutscene. Subtle handheld camera drift. Accurate lip sync. No music, no subtitles, no on-screen text. She finishes the line, then holds a smirk in silence.

shots.prompt: Animate this image into a video with synchronized audio. 3D video game cutscene. The woman finishes applying her lipstick in the compact mirror, snaps the compact shut, turns to the camera and blows a slow flying kiss at the lens, then winks and holds a confident smirk. The camera stays on a close-up of her face and shoulders the whole time. NO graphics or effects appear anywhere on screen. Only sound effects: the compact clicking shut and a soft kiss sound. No speech, no music, no subtitles, no on-screen text.

shots.action: The woman raises her index finger and says
shots.line: Did you know India has more wild tigers than every other country combined?

shots.action: Static locked-off wide shot, the camera does not move or zoom. The woman, leaning on the sea wall, shrugs with open palms and says
shots.line: About three out of every four wild tigers on earth live here.

shots.action: Close-up. The woman tilts her head, raises an eyebrow, and says with a sly grin
shots.line: Like, imagine being a tiger anywhere else. You'd have nobody to talk to.

shots.action: The woman smirks at the camera, taps her chest with her thumb, and says
shots.line: Anyway. I couldn't adopt one, so I wore one.

cta.line: Get yours at your brand dot com. Link in bio.
